payload.reason: Minted on snorkeltoast's migration hypothesis, which their own test refuted. Six captures each of slides 13, 14 and 17, all fifteen pairs at a fixed 1100ms budget: slide 13 zero of 15 differ, slide 17 zero of 15, slide 14 FIVE of 15 and every one at exactly 0.002196. The artefact does not migrate -- slide 14 is BIMODAL, rendering one of two ways with no intermediate value, and slide 13's 0.001500 is a rarer instance of the same class rather than the same instance relocated. So per-slide floors stand as designed and the class-floor mechanism this row required is withdrawn with its proposer's agreement. The concern survives in AC-2.3 in a better form: a floor of 0.000000 recorded for a bimodal slide is a sampling artefact, not a measurement.
